tools.name: egestor_list_contacts
tools.description: List customers, suppliers and carriers. Good first call to find a contact code. eGestor API: GET /v1/contatos.

tools.name: egestor_get_contact
tools.description: Get full data of one contact by code. eGestor API: GET /v1/contatos/{codigo}.

tools.name: egestor_create_contact
tools.description: Create a new contact (customer, supplier or carrier) in eGestor. This writes data and is not idempotent: calling it twice creates two contacts. Returns the new code. eGestor API: POST /v1/contatos.

tools.name: egestor_list_products
tools.description: List products with prices and stock data. eGestor API: GET /v1/produtos.

tools.name: egestor_get_product
tools.description: Get full data of one product by code. eGestor API: GET /v1/produtos/{codigo}.

tools.name: egestor_list_services
tools.description: List services the company sells. eGestor API: GET /v1/servicos.

tools.name: egestor_list_sales
tools.description: List sales (situacao 10 = quote, 50 = sale), filterable by date range and contact. eGestor API: GET /v1/vendas.

tools.name: egestor_get_sale
tools.description: Get full data of one sale: items, payments, totals. eGestor API: GET /v1/vendas/{codigo}.

tools.name: egestor_list_receivables
tools.description: List accounts receivable (situacao 20 = open, 40 = received), filterable by date range. eGestor API: GET /v1/recebimentos.

tools.name: egestor_get_receivable
tools.description: Get one receivable by code. eGestor API: GET /v1/recebimentos/{codigo}.

tools.name: egestor_list_payables
tools.description: List accounts payable (situacao 10 = open, 30 = paid), filterable by date range. eGestor API: GET /v1/pagamentos.

tools.name: egestor_get_payable
tools.description: Get one payable by code. eGestor API: GET /v1/pagamentos/{codigo}.

tools.name: egestor_list_purchases
tools.description: List purchases (situacao 10 = quote, 50 = confirmed), filterable by date range. eGestor API: GET /v1/compras.

tools.name: egestor_get_purchase
tools.description: Get full data of one purchase. eGestor API: GET /v1/compras/{codigo}.

tools.name: egestor_list_accounts
tools.description: List cash boxes and bank accounts (disponiveis). eGestor API: GET /v1/disponiveis.

tools.name: egestor_list_categories
tools.description: List product and finance categories. eGestor API: GET /v1/categorias.

tools.name: egestor_list_users
tools.description: List users and sales people of the account. eGestor API: GET /v1/usuarios.

tools.name: egestor_get_company
tools.description: Get the registration data of the company that owns the token. eGestor API: GET /v1/empresa.
